subject: planner: check select or restore-admin privilege for the refresh cmd (#63822)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent for PR #63822. Change adds planner-side privilege enforcement for `REFRESH STATS` by collecting `visitInfo` requiring `SELECT` at table/db/global scope unless the session has dynamic `RESTORE_ADMIN` (via `RequestDynamicVerification`), with executor integration unchanged. Error selection matches expected MySQL-style codes for table/db scope and `ErrPrivilegeCheckFail` for global scope; cluster-wide broadcast path remains privilege-checked on the initiating node only (remote execution is `IsFromRemote`). Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; the new privilege-check helper remains unchanged and no follow-up fix indicates an unresolved Blocker/High issue.
